# TOWERS OF HANOI (printed "TOWERS OF HAMOT" in the census OCR) - Russell Yankus - DREAMER 15
# pp.16-17 (PDF pages 18-19) - CHIP-8 + 6800, 0080-03FF + display 0100-01C7
# RUN FROM 0080 (0080, FN, 3 - not C000): the 6800 code at 0080 clears the screen below the
# title (0140-01FF) and enters CHIPOS at C005 with the CHIP-8 program counter = 027E.
# Key the number of discs 2-7 (hold the key until the discs appear); they are put on stack 1
# (left). Move them all to stack 3 (right), never a larger disc on a smaller one; stack 2
# (middle) is for temporary storage. Keys 1, 2, 3 = the stacks (from, then to). Illegal moves
# are detected; the score counts the moves (minimum 2^n - 1); at the end the number of moves is
# shown. New game: RST, 0080 FN 3.
# 0100-01C7 is a picture in the display RAM (title, "BY: RUSS YANKUS" and an inverse banner),
# visible while the tape loads; rows 8-31 are cleared by 0080 at run time.
